channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Talks on Hormuz Strait continue; Israel kills 11 in Lebanon
item.description: Israel kills 11 in deadliest attacks on Lebanon since June truce as Iran and Oman continue talks on Hormuz.

item.title: Yemen’s government says Houthi strikes hit residential areas in Marib
item.description: Yemen's Ministry of Information denounces attacks on Marib as 'escalation' that threatens lives and increases suffering.

item.title: Qatar denies Tehran’s claim it is detaining Iranian bomber pilots
item.description: Iran claims Qatar is holding three pilots who were shot down in March. Doha decries 'misleading statements'.

item.title: US aircraft carrier expected to relieve USS Lincoln in Middle East
item.description: The USS Washington's movement comes amid reports of dire conditions on the USS Lincoln amid the ongoing Iran war.

item.title: One killed, dozens injured after wildfire hits Croatian coast
item.description: At least one person was killed and around 42 others were injured after a violent wildfire hit a coastal town in Croatia.

item.title: Rescuers search for survivors of powerful Indonesia earthquake
item.description: Officials say a rapid assessment into the impact of the earthquake that destroyed hundreds of buildings and killed 47 is under way.

item.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
item.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

item.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
item.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.

item.title: Activists try to deliver aid to Palestinians in homes besieged by Israeli settlers
item.description: Two families have been trapped in their homes in the occupied West Bank for several days.
